reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that enables text-only DeepSeek Harness sessions to inspect pasted or file-based images through a configurable vision model and read_image tool.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型提供图片读取能力，可通过 read_image 工具分析会话中的图片或指定路径的图像文件。
summaries.en: Enables text-only DeepSeek Harness models to inspect pasted conversation images or image files through a configurable vision model and the read_image tool.

capabilities: Accepts pasted images on text-only model routes
Projects image blocks into textual image references
Provides a read_image tool for conversation images and image files
Invokes a configured vision model to produce image descriptions
Reads and updates plugin configuration through a settings interface
